answers.workaround:
Sure, just use an icon you like in your projects, but I'd rather prefer to have a good enough default de-facto icon so that it's easy to identify Windows builds in other projects, and Godot Engine is the only entity with decent influence which is able to show a good example for people to follow. 🙂

This is especially important if Godot ever wants to provide general-purpose GitHub actions: #1413.

title: GitHub Actions: change the "Windows Builds" emoji icon to improve visual grepping
